name: Tetris
what: Turn falling blocks to fill lines before the board fills up.
lovedFeatures: Pieces that drop, move and turn
It speeds up as you play
High score saved on your device
scopeNote: A perfect first game. You can have it working in an afternoon.
legalNote: Be extra careful: in 2012 a US court ruled that a game copied too much of how Tetris looks and moves. Change the piece shapes, board size, colors and name, and add your own twist.
